review_type: AI visual review of bounded native white diagnostic
scope: Compared R2 real-render outputs with each raw frame's existing.png, scope.png, and white.png reference for raw098/raw113/raw114. This review is limited to visible black-band suppression, colored fine traces, and nearby vehicle/road impact.

evidence.comparison_note: The reference white.png is a flat spatial fill of the drawn scope. The bounded_native_r2 white.png is the actual rendered contribution-gated result. They are not interchangeable: seeing a flat white reference does not show that Gaussian content was physically removed, and the rendered result need not be a flat raster mask.

overall.black_band: The dark band under the target is reduced/washed out in the R2 render, but a dark gray/black core remains near the lower edge in the three inspected frames. It is not fully gone by visual inspection.
overall.colored_fine_traces: Thin colored/fringed traces remain around the bright patch, most visibly along its upper/right and lower edges. The patch is not uniformly white like the reference fill.
overall.neighbor_and_road: A broad milky/white region affects road pixels inside the drawn scope, as expected for this diagnostic. Outside the main patch the road is largely recognizable. In raw098 the scope/bright patch reaches the left edge of the adjacent silver sedan and appears to disturb part of its outline; in raw113/raw114 the right sedan is largely outside the scope and remains visible. This is a visible scope consequence, not evidence of semantic attribution.
overall.interpretation: The outputs show a bounded local contribution gate rendered through the existing scene, not an automatic semantic detector, full Gaussian identity attribution, background completion, or a verified vehicle-shadow solution. No human ground-truth conclusion is made.

frames.observations: R2 native output replaces much of the bright/colorful car-shaped region with a diffuse white patch, but the lower dark strip/core is still visible and the patch edge is soft rather than flat. Colored fringes remain above and to the right. The large scope visibly reaches the near/left part of the silver sedan, whose nearby contour is partially washed, and whitens a substantial road region inside the polygon. The flat reference white.png is cleaner and harder-edged than R2.
frames.neighbor_road_impact: Noticeable within the broad scope; slight visible intrusion at the adjacent sedan edge.

frames.observations: R2 native shows a broad diffuse white patch over the former vehicle footprint. A dark low core/band remains near the bottom center, and narrow colored traces persist around the upper/right and lower boundaries. Road surface within scope is washed out; the transverse white line below the scope remains recognizable. The right-hand car is mostly outside the scope and remains visible.
frames.neighbor_road_impact: Road pixels inside scope are heavily washed; no strong change to the far-right car is apparent.

frames.observations: R2 native again has a soft white patch, not a flat fill. A dark lower-center residue remains, with colored fine traces around the perimeter, particularly to the right/lower-right. The broad road region inside the scope is washed out; the transverse line and far-right sedan remain mostly recognizable outside it.
frames.neighbor_road_impact: Road pixels inside scope are visibly washed; adjacent sedan remains largely visible.

limits: This is an AI model visual review, not human ground truth; human_verdict is null.
Visual darkness is not sufficient to identify a real cast/contact shadow or assign physical ownership.
The review does not infer Gaussian identity from the spatial gate and does not claim a generalized removal algorithm succeeded.
